frequency_question: How often does a central bank execute an unexpected or signaled rate hike within any given quarter when inflation trends near the upper bound of the target tolerance band?
membership_rule: Includes all scheduled or unscheduled monetary policy rate-setting decisions by the central bank's rate-setting committee where prior core inflation prints exceeded the midpoint of the target band. Excludes decisions made during emergency liquidity injections or systemic crises.
coverage_note: 12 named meetings covering the primary post-pandemic tightening cycle; representative of typical policy pause-to-hike transition frequencies.
known_gaps: Excludes unscheduled inter-meeting announcements, which are statistically rare.
skeleton: RBI rate review cycles evaluated per calendar year across active tightening phases.
multiplier: 12 meetings evaluated; 6 hikes observed during active tightening/hold phase windows.
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions evolve slowly over multi-year structural regimes unless a major leadership overhaul occurs.
